##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 20 September 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure near the Bay of Biscay extending a ridge across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 3 or 4, backing South or Southwest later this evening, occasionally 5 in places overnight and at first tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then occasional rain or drizzle later tonight and at first tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle for a time.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Risk of mist patches.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in mist patches.
